1Ab 06 -00143M-(H) ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AND EASEMENT AGREEMENT (this   8                limited liability company, having an address at c/o Mautner Glick Corp., 1345 Third Avenue, New York, NY 10021 ("Owner"), and Eastside 77 Associates LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, maintaining offices at c/o Alchemy Properties, Inc., 200 Madison Avenue, New York, NY 10016 Attn.: Ken Horn ("Developer"), (Owner and Developer are sometimes hereafter collectively referred to as the "Parties"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee of certain land,with the building and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 5inBlock1452on theTaxMapof theCityof NewYork,and as andby the street address 307 East 77"h Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit “A" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Owner Land"), the building located thereon or which may be located thereon in the future is herein referred to as the "Owner Building"; and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the “Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee of certain land located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County, and State of New York, known as Lots 1 and 2 in Block 1452 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and as and by the street address 1480 and 1482 Second Avenue, New part hereof (said land being herein called me "Developer Land"); WHEREAS, Developer intends  to construct a new building on the Developer Land/renovate/substantially renovate the existing building on the Developer Land, and to construct other improvements associated with such new building/improvement to the existing structure, a portion of which shall cantilever over the Owner Parcel (the new building and improvements/the substantially renovated/improved building and improvements, together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement, are herein collectively referred to as the "Developer Building"; and the Developer Land and the Developer Building are herein collectively referred to as the "Developer Parcel"); WHEREAS, the Owner Building contains less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), than is now available for use on the Owner Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, so that the Transferable Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are available for transfer to and utilization on the DeveloperParcel; WHIEREAS, it is contemplated that the Developer Building will contain more floor area (as hereinafter defined) than is now available for use on the Developer Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), and the parties hereto therefore desire to utilize the procedure available pursuant to the Zoning Resolution for the Merged Zoning Lot (as hereinafter defined) So as to make available the Transferable Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) and/or the Additional Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) for utilization in connection with the Page 1 of 19 1ZLDA 307E77 5t, NYC

construction and maintenance of the Developer Building, and Owner is willing to make such Transferable Development Rights available toDeveloper in perpetuity; WHEREAS, the Developer Parcel is entirely located entirely in a C1-9 zoning district, and the Owner Parcel appears to be split evenly between a C1-9 district and an R8B district. The parties believe that a C1-9 zoning district is deemed equivalent to an R-10 zoning district and within such districts a base maximum residential floor area of 10 may be achieved, and that within an R8B zoning district, the maximum floor area permitted is 4.0. WHIEREAS, it is contemplated that the Developer Building will require the use of a light and air easement and a cantilever easement over and above Owner Parcel, and Developer will herein acquire a Light and Air Easement and Cantilever Easement from Owner as herein provided. As used in this Agreement, the "Light and Air Easement” shall mean the right of Developer, in perpetuity, to use the air space over the entire Owner Parcel for light and air and unobstructed Envelope. As used in this Agreement, the “Cantilever Easement" shall mean the right of Developer, in perpetuity, to use the entire air space over the Owner Parcel to the extent legally permissible starting no less than one hundred twelve (112) feet above the Datum (as used in this of Manhattan, which is 2.75 feet above the National Geodetic Survey Vertical Datum of 1929 (United States Coast and Geodetic Survey) mean sea level, Sandy Hook, New Jersey (the "Easement Starting Plane") in order to cantilever the Developer Building over the Owner Parcel. WHEREAS, Developer may seek to acquire additional development rights (including Development Rights) from any other source other than the Owner Parcel (hereinafter“Additional Developer Building. WHEREAS, the parties hereto are simultaneously herewith executing (i) a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the "Declaration") in accordance with certain provisions set forth in a definition of the term "zoning lot" in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution in order to create a single zoning lot of the Owner Parcel and the Developer Parcel (such zoning lot, as the same may be enlarged or modified in accordance with the Declaration and the terms of this Agreement, is herein referred to as the "Merged Zoning Lot"), and (i) such other agreements, easements and licenses as are reasonably necessary to effectuate the intent of the parties in connection with the Transferable Development Rights (the Declaration and such other agreements, easements and licenses are herein collectively referred to as the “Zoning Documents"); and and obligationsin and to theMerged ZoningLot and other matters. NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby conclusively acknowledged, the parties hereto hereby covenant and agree as follows: 1.
